description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Change the logo, brand colours or fonts on the customer's account (not yours), e.g. after they asked for a change on the brand card. colors.background is the ground the posts are drawn on, colors.text the words on it — the brand card shows exactly that. Black, white or grey is the brand when the website's own background is that colour or the customer says so: keep it. Then send a new brand card so they can approve the result.

background.description: The ground the posts are drawn on: the brand's main colour (an all-black shop: its black).

text.description: The colour of the words written on that ground.

logoUrl.description: A public https URL of the logo image. It is copied to our storage.

onboardingId.description: The onboardingId from the routine payload.
